# External Dependencies

Download the 8th Wall engine binary from https://8th.io/xrjs and unzip it here.

After unzipping, the structure should be:
```
external/
├── xr/
│   ├── xr.js
│   ├── xr-slam.js
│   └── resources/
├── xrextras/
│   ├── xrextras.js
│   └── resources/
├── landing-page/
│   ├── landing-page.js
│   └── resources/
└── scripts/
    └── 8frame-1.5.0.min.js
```
